'''Marith Riven''' is a [[Murandy|Murandian]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Marith Riven}}

== Appearance ==
Marith is 5'6" tall and has not yet achieved the ageless look.

== Strength and Abilities ==
Marith is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|24}}. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to [[Traveling|Travel]].

== History ==
Marith is 32 years old. She was born in [[968 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[984 NE]]. Marith spent eight years as a [[novice]] and seven as [[Accepted]]. She was raised to the shawl in [[999 NE]].

[[Marith Jaen]] was Amyrlin when she was a novice, and it was uncomfortable for her to have the same first name as such a tough Amyrlin.

She had a habit of making observations of people and events that would have been better kept to herself.

== Activities ==
When she was still Accepted, [[Elayne]] threw a cup at her, for which she was switched.

She is chosen to participate in [[Rand]]'s kidnapping, along with [[Beldeine Nyram]] and [[Janine Pavlara]] because they were among the few without the ageless look.

She was taken prisoner by the [[Asha'man]] at the Battle of [[Dumai's Wells]]{{ref/book|6|55}} and swore an oath of fealty to [[Rand al'Thor]]{{ref/book|9|13}} afterwards.

Like many Aes Sedai sworn to Rand, Marith probably fights the [[Last Battle]] on the slopes of [[Thakan'dar]]{{ref/book|14|34}}. Because it is not stated otherwise, it can also be presumed that she survives.

==Ajah==
Marith's Ajah is never identified in the main books of the saga.

Of the thirty-nine sisters sent to kidnap Rand, 15 were of the [[Red Ajah]]. According to [[Galina Casban]], the remaining sisters were 10 of the [[Green Ajah]] and 12 of the [[White Ajah|White]] (the last two are [[Nesune]] e [[Coiren]], a Brown and a Gray respectively).

But Marith's Ajah is identified as Brown in "The Wheel of Time Companion", contradicting the description given by Galina in the Book.
